spots.name: Beqa Shark Reef
spots.bio_draft: Dive site: Shark Reef marine park in the Beqa lagoon, dived from Pacific Harbour with shark-dive operators; the place, not an operator.
spots.reason: Merged with kadavu-region "Shark Reef (Beqa Lagoon)" (same dive site; run from Pacific Harbour). (spot comes from region fiji-viti-levu-central)

spots.name: Navua River
spots.bio_draft: River: Upper Navua Gorge whitewater rafting through black volcanic canyon and waterfalls, reached by road from Navua.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Coral Coast and reached from that base. (spot comes from region fiji-viti-levu-central)

spots.name: Fiji Museum
spots.bio_draft: Museum: national museum of Fiji's history and archaeology (artefacts about 3,700 years old), in Thurston Gardens, Suva; paid entry.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Suva and reached from that base.

spots.name: Colo-i-Suva Forest Reserve
spots.pin_note: source point is a centroid; resolve-pin.py must find the visitor point (OSM feature) before apply
spots.bio_draft: Nature park: rainforest reserve about 10 minutes from central Suva, with Waisila Falls, swimming pools, trails and birdlife.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Suva and reached from that base.

spots.name: Suva Municipal Market
spots.bio_draft: Market: daily fruit and vegetable market on Harris Road, Suva (Mon-Sat), south of the bus station.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Suva and reached from that base.

spots.name: Mount Korobaba
spots.bio_draft: Viewpoint: hill walk above Lami with city and harbour views; the walk starts behind the cement works in Lami.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Suva and reached from that base.

spots.name: Mount Tomanivi
spots.bio_draft: Peak: Fiji's highest point (1,324 m) in the interior of Viti Levu; a climb rather than a managed attraction, no visitor source checked yet. Coordinates lie in the north-west highlands; check which region judges it.
spots.reason: Fiji highest peak, interior Viti Levu, climbed from Nadarivatu/Navala side. About 34 km from Rakiraki centre but outside its 30 km reach (span 40) and not reached from the Suncoast base.
